Why we need silence｜主动安静与短时收益未作答段落信息匹配 / 人物／特征匹配 · 3 段 · 304 词 · 4 题 · 同篇原文另有裁切

真题 · Cambridge IELTS 21 Academic · PDF 第 22 页

Q17：Which section A–G contains the information? Q22/25/26：Match statements with people A–D. You may use any letter more than once.

F（第一段）F Neurobiologist Tai Dotan Ben-Soussan is also an advocate of silence as a therapy. 'When we find ways to be quiet, we are not only quiet in our environment, but quiet in our inner selves,' she explains. 'This allows us to be more aware of what is happening around us and what the situation may require from us so we can provide [a more] adequate response.'

F（第二段）Not everyone will benefit from silence to the same extent, but Ben-Soussan says one characteristic is key: the person must need to want to engage in the experience. 'We see from animal models and human studies that volition and intentionality is important,' she says. 'When people do not want silence, it can be very distressing.'

GEric Pfeifer, a psychotherapy researcher, also concedes that some people may not benefit from silence, particularly those who are in a heightened state of stress. 'People in these states may not be able to relax or calm down in a silent condition,' he says. Professional guidance can be useful, he adds, allowing people to approach silence slowly so that they can gradually enjoy the benefits. And Pfeifer is convinced that silence is more attainable in everyday life than people think. First, complete silence isn't necessary. In a recent study, he found that participants reported more relaxation and less boredom when they sat quietly in an outdoor garden compared with a completely silent room. Second, Pfeifer believes we don't need a lot of silence to gain benefits. 'You don't need to spend hours in silence,' he says. 'It is likely better to have more frequency of silence for a few minutes at a time than a longer period of silence only once a week. Just finding those places in your daily life where you can find some silence ... can make a big difference.'

共用选项 · 原题 22、25、26

  • A Nick Antonio
  • B Justin Feinstein
  • C Tai Dotan Ben-Soussan
  • D Eric Pfeifer

17. evidence that a relatively quiet environment can be more beneficial than a totally silent one

  • A
  • B
  • C
  • D
  • E
  • F
  • G

22. It is unpleasant and upsetting for people to be placed in a silent environment against their will.

25. Even a short amount of silent time can have a positive impact.

26. External and internal quietness makes us more conscious of events occurring in our surroundings and helps us react appropriately to these events.

对照答案，回到证据

第 17 题 · G

必须有两种环境的比较；G中花园与完全静音房间的结果符合题干。

more relaxation and less boredom when they sat quietly in an outdoor garden compared with a completely silent room

第 22 题 · C

F第二段Ben-Soussan把自愿性列为前提，against their will对应do not want。

When people do not want silence, it can be very distressing.

第 25 题 · D

G的Pfeifer明确说几分钟、高频也有益，不要求一次持续数小时。

Just finding those places in your daily life where you can find some silence ... can make a big difference.

第 26 题 · C

F第一段Ben-Soussan提到外部与内在安静，进而更好回应环境。

more aware of what is happening around us and what the situation may require from us

核对原答案页

材料精读 · 内容与词句

安静在这里不是越彻底、越久就越好。文章强调个人意愿、当前心理状态和适应过程，再把理想化的绝对无声，转化为日常中较容易获得的短暂安静。

F（第一段）

F Neurobiologist Tai Dotan Ben-Soussan is also an advocate of silence as a therapy. 'When we find ways to be quiet, we are not only quiet in our environment, but quiet in our inner selves,' she explains. 'This allows us to be more aware of what is happening around us and what the situation may require from us so we can provide [a more] adequate response.'

Ben-Soussan把安静区分为外部环境的安静与内在状态的安静。她认为后者可以帮助人更清楚地觉察周围情况，并作出合宜反应。This承接这种内外安静的状态，而不是单指没有任何声音；本段呈现的是她对安静作用的解释。

F（第二段）

Not everyone will benefit from silence to the same extent, but Ben-Soussan says one characteristic is key: the person must need to want to engage in the experience. 'We see from animal models and human studies that volition and intentionality is important,' she says. 'When people do not want silence, it can be very distressing.'

文章马上加入限制：不同人的获益程度不一样，而且主动愿意参与体验很重要。volition与intentionality指个人的意愿和有意识的参与。如果一个人并不想处于安静之中，这种情境反而可能令人痛苦。因此，安静不能被当成不顾意愿、对所有人都适用的要求。

G

G Eric Pfeifer, a psychotherapy researcher, also concedes that some people may not benefit from silence, particularly those who are in a heightened state of stress. 'People in these states may not be able to relax or calm down in a silent condition,' he says. Professional guidance can be useful, he adds, allowing people to approach silence slowly so that they can gradually enjoy the benefits. And Pfeifer is convinced that silence is more attainable in everyday life than people think. First, complete silence isn't necessary. In a recent study, he found that participants reported more relaxation and less boredom when they sat quietly in an outdoor garden compared with a completely silent room. Second, Pfeifer believes we don't need a lot of silence to gain benefits. 'You don't need to spend hours in silence,' he says. 'It is likely better to have more frequency of silence for a few minutes at a time than a longer period of silence only once a week. Just finding those places in your daily life where you can find some silence ... can make a big difference.'

Pfeifer进一步指出，高度紧张的人有时无法在安静环境中放松，专业指导可以帮助其逐渐适应。他随后提出两个让安静更可获得的想法：不必绝对无声，研究参与者在安静花园中比完全无声的房间更放松、较少无聊；也不必每次持续很久。他倾向于频繁短时的安静，但原文用likely表达判断，并未给出对所有人有效的固定时长处方。

词语与搭配

to the same extent

达到相同程度

用于比较程度；Not everyone...to the same extent表示人与人之间有差异，不是所有人完全没有益处。

engage in the experience

参与并投入这种体验

engage in后接活动或过程；此处强调主动愿意参与，而不只是身体置于安静房间。

a heightened state of stress

一种压力升高、紧张加剧的状态

heightened修饰state所指的程度，描述当时状态，不能直接给某人贴上永久性标签。

a few minutes at a time

每次几分钟

at a time说明单次持续长度，与一周只进行一次但时间很长相对照。

句子精读

Professional guidance can be useful, he adds, allowing people to approach silence slowly so that they can gradually enjoy the benefits.

他补充说，专业指导可能有所帮助，让人慢慢接近和适应安静，从而逐渐享受到其中的益处。

he adds是插入的转述语，he指Pfeifer。allowing...补充说明专业指导如何起作用；so that连接渐进适应与预期收益。can be useful表示可能有帮助，slowly与gradually共同强调过程，而非立即强迫人进入完全无声的状态。

In a recent study, he found that participants reported more relaxation and less boredom when they sat quietly in an outdoor garden compared with a completely silent room.

在近期的一项研究中，他发现参与者报告说，相比待在完全无声的房间里，安静地坐在室外花园中会让他们更放松，也更少感到无聊。

found后的that从句说明研究发现，reported提醒这是参与者报告的体验。when从句描述花园条件，compared with引出对比的房间条件。more relaxation与less boredom是两个并列变化；recent以原文写作时点为参照，句子没有宣称花园对每个人或每种健康状况都更有效。

读完讲解，可以把原文连起来再读一次；想保留的词句可使用已有收藏功能。

The World of Sugar｜全球贸易与误解纠正未作答选择题 · 3 段 · 248 词 · 3 题 · 同篇原文另有裁切

真题 · Cambridge IELTS 21 Academic · PDF 第 26 页

Choose the correct letter A, B, C or D. 原题Q27–29。

原文第1段Ulbe Bosma's The World of Sugar is a genuinely global history. Bosma discusses all the sugar growing places of the world, beginning with Cuba and Java, the largest exporters of the early 20th century. But this is a history not just of cane sugar but also of beet sugar, an equally important form of traded sugar over the last hundred years. Beet sugar is grown mainly in Europe and the United States. It has also been massively subsidised and sold at artificially low prices on world markets, threatening the livelihood of producers of cane sugar.

原文第2段Bosma's discussion of the sugar market in Britain gives a sense of the book's range. The sweet-toothed British first bought cane sugar from their own slavery-dependent colonial plantations. Following the abolition of slavery in the British Empire, cane sugar was imported to Britain from places which retained the practice, such as Cuba and Brazil. Towards the end of the 19th century, the British started to import beet sugar from continental Europe. Only in the 20th century was there a move to develop a national beet sugar industry.

原文第3段The book provides a global labour history, investigating the wide range of labour regimes associated with growing sugar. Contrary to popular belief, cane sugar production was never just restricted to large, dedicated plantations owned by rich men. For example, in Java, a huge exporter of sugar in the early 20th century, sugar cane was grown together with rice in an extraordinarily labour-intensive way by small farmers.

27. What does the reviewer suggest about the cultivation and trading of sugar in the first paragraph?

  • A Sugar has played a major role in international relations.
  • B Beet sugar has been made more internationally competitive.
  • C Cane sugar is thought to be of superior quality to beet sugar.
  • D New locations for cultivating sugar have increased production.

28. In the second paragraph, when discussing the sugar market in Britain, the reviewer stresses

  • A how the sources used changed over time.
  • B how developments in agriculture affected trade.
  • C the increased demand for sugar over the years.
  • D the growing support for ethical methods of cultivation.

29. What is the reviewer doing in the third paragraph?

  • A describing an efficient approach to sugar cultivation
  • B explaining why the use of sugar plantations declined
  • C addressing a misconception about the growing of sugar cane
  • D evaluating different approaches to the cultivation of sugar cane

对照答案，回到证据

第 27 题 · B

补贴让甜菜糖以人为低价竞争，支持B。文中并未比较甘蔗糖品质。

massively subsidised and sold at artificially low prices on world markets

第 28 题 · A

first→Following→Towards the end→Only in the 20th century构成来源随时间变动的序列。

first bought cane sugar from their own slavery-dependent colonial plantations

第 29 题 · C

首句提出劳动力历史，Contrary to popular belief明确纠正普遍误解，小农Java例子服务于该功能。

Contrary to popular belief, cane sugar production was never just restricted to large, dedicated plantations

核对原答案页

材料精读 · 内容与词句

这是一篇书评的开头：作者介绍Bosma如何把糖写成一部全球贸易史和劳动史。甘蔗糖与甜菜糖、进口来源的变化、大种植园与小农生产相互补充，使糖的历史不再只剩单一地区或单一劳动制度。

原文第1段

Ulbe Bosma's The World of Sugar is a genuinely global history. Bosma discusses all the sugar growing places of the world, beginning with Cuba and Java, the largest exporters of the early 20th century. But this is a history not just of cane sugar but also of beet sugar, an equally important form of traded sugar over the last hundred years. Beet sugar is grown mainly in Europe and the United States. It has also been massively subsidised and sold at artificially low prices on world markets, threatening the livelihood of producers of cane sugar.

书评首先评价这是一部真正具有全球范围的糖史，既讨论古巴和爪哇等甘蔗糖出口地，也把欧洲、美国的甜菜糖纳入。随后指出补贴与人为压低的价格会影响世界市场，威胁甘蔗糖生产者的生计。It指甜菜糖这一行业和产品，不能理解为世界上所有糖生产都采用同一制度。

原文第2段

Bosma's discussion of the sugar market in Britain gives a sense of the book's range. The sweet-toothed British first bought cane sugar from their own slavery-dependent colonial plantations. Following the abolition of slavery in the British Empire, cane sugar was imported to Britain from places which retained the practice, such as Cuba and Brazil. Towards the end of the 19th century, the British started to import beet sugar from continental Europe. Only in the 20th century was there a move to develop a national beet sugar industry.

英国市场的进口变化展示了全书的跨度：先从依赖奴役劳动的本国殖民种植园购买甘蔗糖，废奴后仍从保留奴隶制的古巴、巴西等地进口，19世纪末开始进口欧洲甜菜糖，20世纪才发展本国甜菜糖业。这段揭示，某国法律改变与商品供应链中的劳动制度变化并不一定同步。

原文第3段

The book provides a global labour history, investigating the wide range of labour regimes associated with growing sugar. Contrary to popular belief, cane sugar production was never just restricted to large, dedicated plantations owned by rich men. For example, in Java, a huge exporter of sugar in the early 20th century, sugar cane was grown together with rice in an extraordinarily labour-intensive way by small farmers.

作者转向劳动组织的多样性，纠正甘蔗糖始终只由富人拥有的大型专门种植园生产这一单一想象。爪哇的小农曾以高度劳动密集的方式同时种甘蔗和水稻，是这种多样性的一个实例。not just restricted强调不只存在大种植园，并没有否认大种植园的重要历史。

词语与搭配

sold at artificially low prices

以人为压低的价格出售

artificially在这里指价格受到补贴等外部干预，不是说产品是假货；at引出出售价格。

threatening the livelihood of

威胁……的生计

livelihood指赖以谋生的方式和收入基础；此处现在分词说明低价竞争带来的影响。

Following the abolition of slavery

在奴隶制废除之后

following相当于after，标记时间关系；它本身不保证其他国家或供应链也同时发生同样变化。

Contrary to popular belief

与普遍看法相反

用于引入与常见理解不一致的事实，后面需要具体内容或例证支持，不能只把自己的意见写成事实纠正。

an extraordinarily labour-intensive way

一种极为依赖大量劳动投入的方式

labour-intensive描述生产对劳动投入的依赖程度，与单纯技术先进或落后不是同一个概念。

句子精读

It has also been massively subsidised and sold at artificially low prices on world markets, threatening the livelihood of producers of cane sugar.

甜菜糖还获得了巨额补贴，并在世界市场上以人为压低的价格出售，威胁着甘蔗糖生产者的生计。

It承接上句的beet sugar；has been统领subsidised和sold两个被动分词。at引出价格，on world markets说明交易范围。末尾threatening...是补充结果的现在分词短语，说明受影响的是甘蔗糖生产者，而非把两种糖当成同一种生产群体。

For example, in Java, a huge exporter of sugar in the early 20th century, sugar cane was grown together with rice in an extraordinarily labour-intensive way by small farmers.

例如，在20世纪初的重要食糖出口地爪哇，小农以极其劳动密集的方式，把甘蔗与水稻一起种植。

主干是sugar cane was grown...by small farmers。a huge exporter...是Java的同位语，交代地区背景；together with rice说明共同种植的作物，in...way说明生产方式。句子把出口规模大与生产者是小农放在一起，说明两者可以同时成立。

这篇材料里可用于写作的表达

threatening the livelihood of

威胁……的生计

适合用于描述资源衰退或不公平竞争怎样影响依赖某产业谋生的人。可以作为结果分词短语，但要让前面的原因具体可理解。

用于写作：现有题目明确谈过度捕捞对数百万人生计的风险；表达可直接连接鱼类资源减少与沿海家庭收入受损。

读完讲解，可以把原文连起来再读一次；想保留的词句可使用已有收藏功能。

Do animals dream?｜跨物种睡眠研究未作答表格填空 · 4 段 · 355 词 · 5 题 · 同篇原文另有裁切

真题 · Cambridge IELTS 21 Academic · PDF 第 39 页

Complete the table below. Choose ONE WORD ONLY from the passage for each answer. 各行研究结果与评论合并为可输入题面，物种及原空号保留。

原文第1段Studies using electrodes attached to the heads of sleepers have shown that when we sleep, we do so in two ways that alternate throughout the night. The first is rapid eye movement (REM) or active sleep. During this stage our eyes move, even though our eyelids are closed. Our muscles also twitch slightly, though they are largely paralysed so we don't hurt ourselves. In contrast, we also engage in non-REM sleep, during which we barely move at all. Most dream states, and certainly those with the most vivid dreams, happen during REM sleep.

原文第2段There's some evidence that other mammals may also dream. For example, researchers compared the brain patterns of rats running through a maze when awake with their brain patterns during REM sleep. They found the patterns were very similar and concluded that the sleeping rats were dreaming about going through the maze.

原文第3段But finding evidence of dreaming in non-mammals has proved more difficult. Their brains are very different from those of humans, and it can often be difficult to record their activity while they are sleeping. Recently, however, researchers succeeded in recording brain activity in sleeping pigeons. As in mammals, the recordings revealed both REM and non-REM sleep. Intriguingly, REM sleep activity was high in brain regions involved in processing visual information, especially images related to physical activities such as flying, which suggests that this may possibly be what the pigeons were dreaming about.

原文第4段That said, dreaming and REM sleep are unlikely to be universal in the animal kingdom. For example, sponges don't have brains, so they lack the machinery for dreaming. There are also some animals with unusual sleep patterns. These include whales and dolphins, which do not shut down their entire brain when they sleep, but only half of it, keeping the rest awake. They also show no sign of REM sleep, suggesting that they may only experience non-REM dreams, which are less vivid. This is surprising because we tend to think of whales and dolphins as having complex inner lives. It's thought that they don't experience REM sleep because during REM sleep animals are more vulnerable to extremes of temperature.

1. Research into sleep and dreaming — 1 __________: similar brain patterns were observed when active and sleeping; indicative of dreaming

2. Pigeons: when sleeping, pigeons displayed activity in parts of the brain that deal with 2 __________ input; may have been dreaming of flying

3. Whales and dolphins: still have 3 __________ their brain awake when they sleep

4. Whales and dolphins: don't experience REM sleep, as this could affect their sensitivity to 4 __________

5. Whales and dolphins: their dreams are probably not very 5 __________

对照答案，回到证据

第 1 题 · rats

表格此行要求动物类别；清醒走迷宫与REM睡眠对比的是rats。

the brain patterns of rats running through a maze when awake with their brain patterns during REM sleep

第 2 题 · visual

input对应information；空前deal with与processing相对应，所需形容词为visual。

brain regions involved in processing visual information

第 3 题 · half

只关闭一半，所以另一半保持清醒。句子逻辑转换但数值不变。

only half of it, keeping the rest awake

第 4 题 · temperature

原因落在末句；temperature而不是前文machinery或lives。

during REM sleep animals are more vulnerable to extremes of temperature

第 5 题 · vivid

less vivid改写为not very vivid；保持形容词词性。

non-REM dreams, which are less vivid

核对原答案页

材料精读 · 内容与词句

作者从人类的两种睡眠状态出发，逐步追问其他动物是否也做梦。脑活动记录提供了跨物种比较的线索，但动物无法直接报告梦境，所以观察到的睡眠特征与对主观体验的推测始终需要区分。

原文第1段

Studies using electrodes attached to the heads of sleepers have shown that when we sleep, we do so in two ways that alternate throughout the night. The first is rapid eye movement (REM) or active sleep. During this stage our eyes move, even though our eyelids are closed. Our muscles also twitch slightly, though they are largely paralysed so we don't hurt ourselves. In contrast, we also engage in non-REM sleep, during which we barely move at all. Most dream states, and certainly those with the most vivid dreams, happen during REM sleep.

电极研究表明，人的睡眠在快速眼动与非快速眼动状态之间交替。快速眼动时眼球活动、肌肉可能轻微抽动，但大部分肌肉受到抑制；非快速眼动时身体几乎不动。多数梦境，尤其生动的梦，与快速眼动睡眠相连。本段提供后文比较动物的基础，但most没有把全部梦境都限定在一种状态。

原文第2段

There's some evidence that other mammals may also dream. For example, researchers compared the brain patterns of rats running through a maze when awake with their brain patterns during REM sleep. They found the patterns were very similar and concluded that the sleeping rats were dreaming about going through the maze.

研究者比较老鼠清醒走迷宫时和快速眼动睡眠中的脑活动，发现两者相似，因此推测老鼠可能在梦中重现走迷宫的经历。这里先有脑活动模式的观察，再有对梦内容的解释；开头some evidence和may保留了动物内在体验无法直接验证的限制。

原文第3段

But finding evidence of dreaming in non-mammals has proved more difficult. Their brains are very different from those of humans, and it can often be difficult to record their activity while they are sleeping. Recently, however, researchers succeeded in recording brain activity in sleeping pigeons. As in mammals, the recordings revealed both REM and non-REM sleep. Intriguingly, REM sleep activity was high in brain regions involved in processing visual information, especially images related to physical activities such as flying, which suggests that this may possibly be what the pigeons were dreaming about.

研究非哺乳动物更困难，因为脑结构不同，睡眠中的脑活动也更难记录。鸽子的记录显示两类睡眠状态，并且快速眼动时视觉信息处理区域较活跃，特别涉及飞行等身体活动的影像。作者因此提出可能与相应梦境有关，但suggests、may和possibly层层保留推测，不能直接写成研究人员看到了鸽子的梦。

原文第4段

That said, dreaming and REM sleep are unlikely to be universal in the animal kingdom. For example, sponges don't have brains, so they lack the machinery for dreaming. There are also some animals with unusual sleep patterns. These include whales and dolphins, which do not shut down their entire brain when they sleep, but only half of it, keeping the rest awake. They also show no sign of REM sleep, suggesting that they may only experience non-REM dreams, which are less vivid. This is surprising because we tend to think of whales and dolphins as having complex inner lives. It's thought that they don't experience REM sleep because during REM sleep animals are more vulnerable to extremes of temperature.

That said转向适用范围：梦和快速眼动不太可能遍布所有动物。海绵没有大脑；鲸与海豚只让半侧大脑进入睡眠，文中说它们没有快速眼动睡眠迹象，进而推测可能只有较不生动的非快速眼动梦。末句以It's thought提出一种温度脆弱性的解释，属于学术推测，不是确定且唯一的原因。

词语与搭配

alternate throughout the night

整夜交替出现

alternate表示两种状态轮流变化，throughout覆盖整个夜间；不意味着只切换一次。

the most vivid dreams

最鲜明生动的梦境

vivid描述体验或画面鲜明，不等于这些梦更真实地反映外部世界。

recording brain activity

记录脑活动

指获取神经活动数据，不能等同于直接读取一段完整主观体验。

complex inner lives

复杂的内在精神生活

inner lives涉及感受、记忆等内在体验；文中是人类对鲸与海豚的通常认识，而非本文逐一证实的内容。

more vulnerable to extremes of temperature

更容易受到极端温度影响

vulnerable to后接潜在威胁；more比较的是不同睡眠状态中的脆弱程度。

句子精读

Intriguingly, REM sleep activity was high in brain regions involved in processing visual information, especially images related to physical activities such as flying, which suggests that this may possibly be what the pigeons were dreaming about.

有趣的是，快速眼动睡眠期间，与处理视觉信息有关的脑区活动较强，尤其涉及飞行等身体活动的影像；这提示，鸽子当时可能梦到的正是这些内容。

involved in...是过去分词短语修饰brain regions；related to...修饰images；such as flying给出身体活动的例子。which承接前面整个观察，this指相关视觉和身体活动内容。suggests、may possibly都说明从脑活动到梦内容是推断，what...是表语从句，表示鸽子梦到的内容。

These include whales and dolphins, which do not shut down their entire brain when they sleep, but only half of it, keeping the rest awake.

这类动物包括鲸和海豚，它们睡觉时并不会让整个大脑都停止清醒活动，而是只让其中一半进入睡眠，让剩下的一半保持清醒。

These指上文具有特殊睡眠模式的动物。which引导补充说明鲸和海豚的从句；not...but...纠正范围，从整个大脑缩小到半个。it指brain，the rest指另一半；keeping...说明与此同时保持的状态。shut down在这里是通俗叙述，不能机械理解为生理活动完全归零。

Mapungubwe｜农业、居所与社会等级未作答段落信息匹配 · 3 段 · 414 词 · 3 题 · 同篇原文另有裁切

真题 · Cambridge IELTS 21 Academic · PDF 第 43 页

Which paragraph contains the following information? Write A–G. 保留完整原候选字母；本片段为A–C，C跨PDF43–44页连续接回。

AMapungubwe, which was one of the first states in southern Africa, was formed by Bantu-speaking peoples who were farmers. The area controlled by the rulers of Mapungubwe had at its heart a large sandstone plateau, which was easily defended due to its inaccessibility. As with other kingdoms in the region of southern Africa, cattle herding and other types of farming brought plenty of food and a surplus that could be traded for needed goods. Archaeology has revealed extensive layers of bones and manure, which indicate that from the 9th century CE there were large cattle herds, the traditional source of political power in southern African communities. The archaeological record for the 10th century shows a marked increase in the number of domesticated cattle in the area as well as cotton cultivation and weaving, as indicated by abundant finds of spindle whorls.

BThe total population of Mapungubwe at its peak in the mid-13th century was around 5,000 people. The chief or king of Mapungubwe was likely the wealthiest individual in the society, and would have owned more cattle and precious materials than anyone else. The king and his advisers dwelt in a stone enclosure composed of stone walls and housing built on the highest level of the community's territory, a natural sandstone hill which is some 30 metres high and 100 metres in length. Occupation on the hill dates from the 11th century and the entire complex was surrounded by a wooden palisade*, as indicated by postholes made in the rock. The rest of the community lived in mud and thatch housing spread out below the hill, although there is one stone structure here. This settlement, known as Babandyanalo, covers around 5 hectares (12.3 acres) and predates the hilltop structures.

CThe kings of Mapungubwe were buried at the top of the hill site in a demarcated area away from the dwellings, while other members of the community were buried at the surrounding valley level. A wooden staircase connected the two levels, the sockets for the steps being clearly visible in the sandstone cliff face. There were some grander residences dotted around the outskirts of Babandyanalo, and these probably belonged to male relatives of the king. There are many other smaller but still impressive sites across the Mapungubwe plateau, which are located anywhere from 15 to 100 kilometres from the major hill site. Containing stone residences and walls, they likely belonged to local chiefs who acted as servants to the king.

* palisade: typically a row of closely placed, high vertical wooden or iron posts used as a means of defence

  • A
  • B

16. a mention of the location where members of the king's family are thought to have lived

18. an estimate of the size to which the Mapungubwe community grew

第 18 题 · B

size指人口规模，peak与around表示高峰估计值；不是面积5 hectares。

材料精读 · 内容与词句

文章借农业遗存、住宅位置与墓地分布重建Mapungubwe的社会结构。食物盈余支持贸易，牛群与权力相关，高低不同的居所和埋葬地点则展示社会等级；部分身份判断来自考古推测，保留likely和probably的限度。

A

A Mapungubwe, which was one of the first states in southern Africa, was formed by Bantu-speaking peoples who were farmers. The area controlled by the rulers of Mapungubwe had at its heart a large sandstone plateau, which was easily defended due to its inaccessibility. As with other kingdoms in the region of southern Africa, cattle herding and other types of farming brought plenty of food and a surplus that could be traded for needed goods. Archaeology has revealed extensive layers of bones and manure, which indicate that from the 9th century CE there were large cattle herds, the traditional source of political power in southern African communities. The archaeological record for the 10th century shows a marked increase in the number of domesticated cattle in the area as well as cotton cultivation and weaving, as indicated by abundant finds of spindle whorls.

Mapungubwe由说班图语、从事农业的人群建立，控制区域以难以接近、易于防守的砂岩高地为中心。畜牧和种植带来食物盈余，可用于交换物资。骨骼、粪便和纺轮等遗存支持关于牛群、棉花种植及织布的认识，牛在当地传统中也与政治权力相连。作者把地理条件、生产能力和国家形成放在同一背景中。

B

B The total population of Mapungubwe at its peak in the mid-13th century was around 5,000 people. The chief or king of Mapungubwe was likely the wealthiest individual in the society, and would have owned more cattle and precious materials than anyone else. The king and his advisers dwelt in a stone enclosure composed of stone walls and housing built on the highest level of the community's territory, a natural sandstone hill which is some 30 metres high and 100 metres in length. Occupation on the hill dates from the 11th century and the entire complex was surrounded by a wooden palisade*, as indicated by postholes made in the rock. The rest of the community lived in mud and thatch housing spread out below the hill, although there is one stone structure here. This settlement, known as Babandyanalo, covers around 5 hectares (12.3 acres) and predates the hilltop structures.

13世纪中叶鼎盛时，人口约为5000。国王可能拥有最多的牛和珍贵物品，他与顾问居住在高处石墙围成的建筑群，普通居民住在山下泥土与茅草房中。岩石柱洞提供木栅栏存在的线索。山下Babandyanalo聚落早于山顶建筑，这说明空间上的高低与建筑形成的先后是不同维度，不能把山上自动理解为最早居住区。

C

C The kings of Mapungubwe were buried at the top of the hill site in a demarcated area away from the dwellings, while other members of the community were buried at the surrounding valley level. A wooden staircase connected the two levels, the sockets for the steps being clearly visible in the sandstone cliff face. There were some grander residences dotted around the outskirts of Babandyanalo, and these probably belonged to male relatives of the king. There are many other smaller but still impressive sites across the Mapungubwe plateau, which are located anywhere from 15 to 100 kilometres from the major hill site. Containing stone residences and walls, they likely belonged to local chiefs who acted as servants to the king.

社会等级也延续到墓地：国王葬在山顶划定区域，其他居民葬在周围谷地，两层由木梯连接。山下外围较大的住宅可能属于男性王族，远处较小但精致的石筑遗址可能属于侍奉国王的地方首领。probably和likely保留了所有者身份的推断性；这些建筑共同提示一个中心与周边相联系的权力网络。

词语与搭配

due to its inaccessibility

由于它难以接近

due to引出原因，its指砂岩高地；这里困难的交通条件反而带来防御优势。

a surplus that could be traded

可以用于交易的盈余

surplus指超过自身即时需要的部分，could表明交换的可能性；不是所有产出都拿去交易。

a marked increase in the number of domesticated cattle

家养牛数量的显著增加

marked强调变化明显，the number of后接复数名词；本段依据考古记录作出描述，没有给出精确增长百分比。

predates the hilltop structures

早于山顶建筑

predate是动词，直接接较晚出现的事物，说明时间先后，而非评价建筑的重要性。

dotted around the outskirts

零星分布在外围

dotted around形容分散布局，outskirts通常指聚落边缘；这里描述较大住宅的空间位置。

句子精读

The archaeological record for the 10th century shows a marked increase in the number of domesticated cattle in the area as well as cotton cultivation and weaving, as indicated by abundant finds of spindle whorls.

10世纪的考古记录显示，当地家养牛的数量明显增加，同时出现棉花种植和织布活动，丰富的纺轮发现提供了相关线索。

主语是The archaeological record，shows后并列牛群增加与棉花种植、织布两类信息。as well as用于增补，末尾as indicated by...说明证据关系；纺轮直接支持的是纺织活动，不应机械理解成纺轮证明了牛群数量。for the 10th century限定记录所属时期。

The king and his advisers dwelt in a stone enclosure composed of stone walls and housing built on the highest level of the community's territory, a natural sandstone hill which is some 30 metres high and 100 metres in length.

国王和他的顾问住在由石墙与房屋组成的围区里，建筑位于聚落领地的最高处，也就是一座大约高30米、长100米的天然砂岩山丘上。

主干是The king and his advisers dwelt in a stone enclosure。composed of...与built on...逐层补充围区的构成和位置；a natural sandstone hill对最高处作同位说明。which修饰hill，some在数字前表示约数而非一些山丘。

Artificial Intelligence｜公众想象与解决一切的误区未作答选择题 · 3 段 · 202 词 · 2 题 · 同篇原文另有裁切

真题 · Cambridge IELTS 21 Academic · PDF 第 47 页

Choose the correct letter A, B, C or D. 原题Q27–28。

原文第1段In many countries in the West, hysteria about the future of artificial intelligence (AI) is everywhere. There seems to be no shortage of sensationalist news about how AI could cure diseases, accelerate human innovation and improve human creativity. Just looking at the media headlines, you might think that we are already living in a future where AI has infiltrated every aspect of society.

原文第2段While it is undeniable that AI has opened up a wealth of promising opportunities, it has also led to the emergence of a mindset that can be best described as 'AI solutionism'. This is the philosophy that, given enough data, machine learning algorithms can solve all of humanity's problems. But, in fact, instead of supporting AI progress, this mindset actually jeopardises the value of machine intelligence by disregarding important AI safety principles and setting unrealistic expectations about what AI can really do for humanity.

原文第3段In only a few years, AI solutionism has made its way from the technology evangelists' mouths in Silicon Valley in California to the minds of government officials and policymakers around the world. The pendulum has swung from the dystopian notion that AI will destroy humanity to the utopian belief that our algorithmic saviour is here.

27. What is the writer doing in the first paragraph?

  • A predicting the future impact of AI
  • B describing a public perception of AI
  • C outlining some possible benefits of AI
  • D highlighting the breadth of the influence of AI

28. When discussing AI solutionism in the second paragraph, the writer

  • A points out a risk involved.
  • B specifies its probable origins.
  • C mentions its chief supporters.
  • D weighs up some pros and cons.

对照答案，回到证据

第 27 题 · B

you might think标记媒体造成的公众印象，不是作者预测AI一定实现所有益处。

Just looking at the media headlines, you might think that we are already living in a future where AI has infiltrated every aspect of society.

第 28 题 · A

jeopardises与disregarding safety/setting unrealistic expectations明确提出这种思维的风险，未追溯起源或列主要支持者。

this mindset actually jeopardises the value of machine intelligence

核对原答案页

材料精读 · 内容与词句

三段讨论人们如何想象AI：媒体渲染的未来图景，认为数据充足就能解决一切的心态，以及这种心态向政策圈的传播。作者承认技术机会，同时批评把机会扩大成万能承诺的思维。

原文第1段

In many countries in the West, hysteria about the future of artificial intelligence (AI) is everywhere. There seems to be no shortage of sensationalist news about how AI could cure diseases, accelerate human innovation and improve human creativity. Just looking at the media headlines, you might think that we are already living in a future where AI has infiltrated every aspect of society.

第1段写西方许多国家对AI未来的强烈情绪和追求轰动的新闻。could所列的是新闻谈论的潜在能力，you might think则描述只看标题可能形成的印象；不能把“渗透社会每一方面”读成作者已经确认的现状。

原文第2段

While it is undeniable that AI has opened up a wealth of promising opportunities, it has also led to the emergence of a mindset that can be best described as 'AI solutionism'. This is the philosophy that, given enough data, machine learning algorithms can solve all of humanity's problems. But, in fact, instead of supporting AI progress, this mindset actually jeopardises the value of machine intelligence by disregarding important AI safety principles and setting unrealistic expectations about what AI can really do for humanity.

第2段先承认AI带来大量有前景的机会，再引出“AI万能解决论”。given enough data属于这一心态的信念前提，不是作者承诺数据足够便能解决全部问题。后半说明作者担忧的是忽视安全与制造不现实预期，批评对象是这种思维，而不是一概否定AI。

原文第3段

In only a few years, AI solutionism has made its way from the technology evangelists' mouths in Silicon Valley in California to the minds of government officials and policymakers around the world. The pendulum has swung from the dystopian notion that AI will destroy humanity to the utopian belief that our algorithmic saviour is here.

第3段从心态本身转向传播路径：技术圈的宣传进入政府官员和政策制定者的思考。钟摆比喻描述态度由“毁灭人类”转向“拯救人类”的另一个极端；dystopian和utopian分别标出极度悲观与理想化信念，不能当成作者对未来的两项预测。

词语与搭配

no shortage of

大量；并不缺少

后接名词，强调数量充足。此处修饰sensationalist news，数量多并不等于内容可靠。

a wealth of promising opportunities

大量有前景的机会

a wealth of后接不可数或复数名词；promising表示值得期待，不表示成果已经兑现。

given enough data

在数据足够的条件下

given在此引出前提。整个条件位于被解释的信念之内，不能脱离上下文当成作者认可的规律。

setting unrealistic expectations about

对……设定不切实际的预期

set expectations about后面说明预期涉及什么；unrealistic批评的是与实际能力不相称的期望。

The pendulum has swung

钟摆已经摆向另一边；态度转向另一极端

这里是态度变化的比喻，from...to...指出两个极端，不描述机器性能的变化。

句子精读

While it is undeniable that AI has opened up a wealth of promising opportunities, it has also led to the emergence of a mindset that can be best described as 'AI solutionism'.

虽然不可否认AI已经打开了大量有前景的机会，但它也促成了一种心态的出现；这种心态最贴切的名称可以说是“AI万能解决论”。

While表示让步；it is undeniable that...里的it是形式主语，that从句是所承认的内容。主句it has also led...中的it回指AI；that can be best described...修饰mindset，说明如何称呼这种心态。

But, in fact, instead of supporting AI progress, this mindset actually jeopardises the value of machine intelligence by disregarding important AI safety principles and setting unrealistic expectations about what AI can really do for humanity.

但事实上，这种心态没有支持AI的发展，反而因为忽视重要的AI安全原则，并对AI实际能为人类做什么设定不现实的期望，而危及机器智能的价值。

this mindset回指AI solutionism；instead of supporting与actually jeopardises构成对照。by后面disregarding和setting并列，说明造成风险的两种方式。what从句说明预期涉及的实际能力范围。

这篇材料里可用于写作的表达

setting unrealistic expectations about

对……设定不切实际的预期

可在avoid等动词后保留setting形式，具体说明期待的成果或时间；不把所有期待都说成不切实际。

用于写作：自编例句，贴合政府科研职责，说明资助研究时如何理解成果周期；并不据此推出应排除私营研究。

no shortage of

大量；不缺

可以承认数字内容数量充足，再讨论数量之外的体验差异。

用于写作：自编例句，直接回应线上娱乐与影院价值：先承认线上内容丰富，再解释共同观看体验这一文化维度。
